title: Johann Scheepers
text:
I am a PhD student in the Department of Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering at the University of Waterloo, advised by Prof. Kaan Inal. My research is supported by General Motors Canada.
My work sits at the intersection of machine learning and computational mechanics. I trained and study Deep Learning approaches to understand complex material systems and accelerate simulations involving them.
Previously, I completed my BASc. in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Waterloo.

title: Johann Scheepers
text:
Research Interests

Deep Learning Surrogate Models — Using advanced neural network architectures to replace computationally expensive material models.
ML Deployment — Once a model is built, it needs to run somewhere, either locally, on GPU cluster, or sometimes as part of a more complex simulation system. I develop methods of doing the latter with fewer headaches.

title: How I Set Up This Website with Quarto
text:
Deploying to GitHub Pages
# One-time setup
quarto publish gh-pages

# Subsequent updates
git add . && git commit -m "Update"
quarto publish gh-pages
That’s it — Quarto handles building and pushing to the gh-pages branch automatically. Your site will be live at https://yourusername.github.io.
